surface.label: Surface
surface.refusal: An opening stands on page, raised, inverse, tint, brand or accent, not on {value}. Leave it out for the design's own.

surface.label: Surface
surface.refusal: A section stands on page, raised, inverse, tint, brand or accent, not on {value}.

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.refusal: A section's anchor is lowercase letters a to z, digits, hyphens and underscores, so {value} cannot be one.

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.refusal: A fact box's anchor is lowercase letters a to z, digits, hyphens and underscores, so {value} cannot be one.

type.label: Type
type.refusal: A styled list is description, values, logos or actions, not {value}. Leave the type out for a list with the design's bullets or markers.

markers.label: Markers
markers.refusal: Markers are one value for each level, the levels apart by /: v or ✓ for a check, x or ✗ for a cross, or a numbering, 1, a, A, i, I, α or aa, with a full stop or a bracket after it, or in brackets, and dotted below the first level, such as 1./a) or 1/1.1. {value} is none of those.

type.label: Type
type.refusal: Cards are of the type navigation, or of none, not {value}.

markers.label: Markers
markers.refusal: Cards take one marker: v or ✓ for a check, x or ✗ for a cross, or a numbering, 1, a, A, i, I, α or aa, with a full stop or a bracket after it, or in brackets. {value} is none of those.

picture.label: Picture
picture.refusal: A card's picture stands behind its text, or above it where this is left out, not {value}.

symbol.label: Symbol
symbol.refusal: A card's symbol stands by the card, item, or in its heading, heading, not {value}.

first.label: First item
first.refusal: An accordion's first item is open or closed, not {value}.

expand.label: Open at once
expand.refusal: An accordion opens one item at a time or many, not {value}.
